measures.name: volum_consumit_global_acum_12m
measures.dax:
VAR _FechaFin =
CALCULATE(
MAX('fact_aigua_consum_historic'[fecha]),
ALL('fact_aigua_consum_historic')
)
VAR _FechaInicio =    EDATE ( _FechaFin, -11 )
VAR _FechaMinContexto =    MIN ( 'dim_calendario'[Date] )
VAR _FechaMaxContexto =    MAX ( 'dim_calendario'[Date] )
VAR _Valor =
CALCULATE (
SUM(fact_aigua_consum_historic[aigua_consumida_total]),
DATESINPERIOD (
'dim_calendario'[Date],
_FechaMaxContexto,
-12,
MONTH
)
)
RETURN
IF (
_FechaMaxContexto < _FechaInicio
|| _FechaMinContexto > _FechaFin,
BLANK (),
DIVIDE ( _Valor, 1000000 )
)
measures.description: Calcula suma de fact_aigua_consum_historic[aigua_consumida_total] dins del període. Divideix el resultat per 1.000.000.
measures.unit: hm³ si la font és m³
measures.period: Finestra de 12 mesos fins a la data màxima del context. Retorna buit fora del rang de dates admès

measures.name: l_km_global_ytd
measures.dax:
VAR FechaMaxContexto =
MAX ( 'dim_calendario'[Date] )
VAR AnioActual =
YEAR ( FechaMaxContexto )
VAR UltimaFechaConDato =
MAXX (
FILTER (
ALL ( 'dim_calendario' ),
YEAR ( 'dim_calendario'[Date] ) = AnioActual
&& 'dim_calendario'[Date] <= FechaMaxContexto
&& NOT ISBLANK (
CALCULATE ( [l_km_mensual] )
)
&& CALCULATE ( [l_km_mensual] ) <> 0
),
'dim_calendario'[Date]
)
RETURN

REMOVEFILTERS ( 'dim_calendario' ),
'dim_calendario'[Date] = UltimaFechaConDato
)

"Has seleccionat analitzar els KPIs en periode "
VAR texto_generico_2 =
" per tant ara el teu objectiu és el mateix KPI en el període "
VAR Periodo =

CALCULATE(
MAX(dim_calendario[Date]),
ALL(dim_calendario)
)
VAR FechaInicio =
SWITCH(
Periodo,
"Acumulat", DATE(YEAR(FechaReferencia), 1, 1),
"12 Mesos", EDATE(FechaReferencia, -11),
FechaReferencia
)
VAR FechaFin =
SWITCH(
Periodo,
"Mensual", EDATE(FechaReferencia, -12),
"Diff", EDATE(FechaReferencia, -12),
FechaReferencia
)
VAR MesInicio =
SWITCH(
MONTH(FechaInicio),
1, "Gen",
2, "Febr",
3, "Març",
4, "Abr",
5, "Maig",
6, "Juny",
7, "Jul",
8, "Ag",
9, "Set",
10, "Oct",
11, "Nov",
12, "Des"
)
& " "
& FORMAT(FechaInicio, "yy")
VAR MesFin =
SWITCH(
MONTH(FechaFin),
1, "Gen",
2, "Febr",
3, "Març",
4, "Abr",
5, "Maig",
6, "Juny",
7, "Jul",
8, "Ag",
9, "Set",
10, "Oct",
11, "Nov",
12, "Des"
)
& " "
& FORMAT(FechaFin, "yy")
VAR TextoPeriodo =
SWITCH(
Periodo,
"Mensual", "MENSUAL",
"12 Mesos", "12 MESOS",
"Acumulat", "ACUMULAT",
"Diff", "DIFF",
BLANK()
)
VAR TextoDetalle =
SWITCH(
Periodo,
"Mensual",
texto_generico_2 & "MMAA: " & MesInicio & " vs " & MesFin,
"Diff",
texto_generico_2 & "MMAA: " & MesInicio & " vs " & MesFin,
"Acumulat",
": " & MesInicio & " — " & MesFin,
"12 Mesos",
": " & MesInicio & " vs " & MesFin
)
RETURN

ISBLANK(TextoPeriodo),
BLANK(),
texto_generico_1 & TextoPeriodo & TextoDetalle

measures.name: kpi_anr_dia_m3_switch
measures.dax:
VAR _Periodo =
SELECTEDVALUE(dummy_slicer_periodo[Periodo]) & ""
VAR _EsContextoMes =
ISINSCOPE('dim_calendario'[mes_corto])
|| ISINSCOPE('dim_calendario'[anio_mes])
VAR _UltimaFechaConDato =
MAXX(
FILTER(
ALLSELECTED('dim_calendario'[Date]),
NOT ISBLANK(
CALCULATE([anr_dia_m3_mensual])
)
),
'dim_calendario'[Date]
)
RETURN
SWITCH(
_Periodo,
"Mensual",
IF(
_EsContextoMes,
[anr_dia_m3_mensual],
CALCULATE(
[anr_dia_m3_mensual],
REMOVEFILTERS('dim_calendario'),
'dim_calendario'[Date] = _UltimaFechaConDato
)
),
"12 Mesos",
[anr_dia_m3_acum_12m],
"Acumulat",
[anr_dia_m3_ytd],
"Diff",
IF(
_EsContextoMes,
[anr_dia_m3_diff],
VAR _UltimaFechaDiff =
MAXX(
FILTER(
ALLSELECTED('dim_calendario'[Date]),
NOT ISBLANK(
CALCULATE([anr_dia_m3_diff])
)
),
'dim_calendario'[Date]
)
RETURN

VAR _Periodo =
SELECTEDVALUE(dummy_slicer_periodo[Periodo]) & ""

ISINSCOPE('dim_calendario'[mes_corto])
RETURN

[volum_lliurat_global_mensual_hm3],
"12 Mesos",
[volum_lliurat_global_acum_12m_hm3],

[volum_lliurat_global_ytd],
"Diff",
IF(
_EsContextoMes,
-- En el grÃ¡fico: diferencia mes a mes
[volum_lliurat_global_diff],
-- En la tarjeta KPI: Ãºltimo Diff disponible
VAR _UltimaFechaConDato =
MAXX(
FILTER(
ALLSELECTED('dim_calendario'[Date]),
NOT ISBLANK(
CALCULATE([volum_lliurat_global_diff])
)
),
'dim_calendario'[Date]
)
RETURN
CALCULATE(
[volum_lliurat_global_diff],
REMOVEFILTERS('dim_calendario'[Date]),
'dim_calendario'[Date] = _UltimaFechaConDato
)
),

)

measures.name: color_kpi_fraus_switch
measures.dax:
VAR _Kpi =
SELECTEDVALUE('_parameter_fraus'[Parámetro])
VAR _Valor =
SWITCH(
_Kpi,
"Fraus Detectats", [kpi_fraus_detectats_switch],
"Fraus Recuperat (m3)", [kpi_fraus_m3_switch],
"Fraus Total Import", [kpi_fraus_total_import_switch],
"Fraus Recuperats", [kpi_fraus_recuperats_switch],
"% Fraus Recuperacio", [kpi_pct_fraudes_recupera_switch],
BLANK()
)
VAR _Escala =
SWITCH(
_Kpi,
"Fraus Detectats", [escala_color_fraus_detectats],
"Fraus Recuperat (m3)", [escala_color_fraus_m3],
"Fraus Total Import", [escala_color_fraus_import],
"Fraus Recuperats", [escala_color_fraus_recuperats],
"% Fraus Recuperacio", 1,
BLANK()
)
VAR _Nivel =
MIN(1, MAX(0, DIVIDE(_Valor, _Escala, 0)))
RETURN
SWITCH(
TRUE(),
ISBLANK(_Kpi) || ISBLANK(_Valor), BLANK(),
_Kpi = "Fraus Detectats" && _Nivel = 0, "#FFFFFF",
_Kpi = "Fraus Detectats" && _Nivel <= 0.25, "#E2F0D9",
_Kpi = "Fraus Detectats" && _Nivel <= 0.50, "#A9D18E",
_Kpi = "Fraus Detectats" && _Nivel <= 0.75, "#F4B183",
_Kpi = "Fraus Detectats", "#C00000",
_Kpi IN {"Fraus Recuperat (m3)", "Fraus Total Import"} && _Nivel = 0, "#FFFFFF",
_Kpi IN {"Fraus Recuperat (m3)", "Fraus Total Import"} && _Nivel <= 0.25, "#E2F0D9",
_Kpi IN {"Fraus Recuperat (m3)", "Fraus Total Import"} && _Nivel <= 0.50, "#A9D18E",
_Kpi IN {"Fraus Recuperat (m3)", "Fraus Total Import"} && _Nivel <= 0.75, "#70AD47",
_Kpi IN {"Fraus Recuperat (m3)", "Fraus Total Import"}, "#548235",
_Kpi = "Fraus Recuperats" && _Nivel = 0, "#C00000",
_Kpi = "Fraus Recuperats" && _Nivel <= 0.25, "#F4B183",
_Kpi = "Fraus Recuperats" && _Nivel <= 0.50, "#FFD966",
_Kpi = "Fraus Recuperats" && _Nivel <= 0.75, "#A9D18E",
_Kpi = "Fraus Recuperats", "#548235",
_Kpi = "% Fraus Recuperacio" && _Nivel <= 0.25, "#C00000",
_Kpi = "% Fraus Recuperacio" && _Nivel <= 0.50, "#F4B183",
_Kpi = "% Fraus Recuperacio" && _Nivel <= 0.75, "#A9D18E",
_Kpi = "% Fraus Recuperacio", "#548235",
BLANK()
)
